mapper.insert: insert into dish (name, category_id, price, image, description, status, stock, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{status}, #{stock}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update dish set stock = stock + #{quantity} where id = #{dishId}
